nuggets.text: Robert Saleh opens his first season as Titans head coach against the Jets, his former team.
Cam Ward was the first zero-star recruit taken No. 1 overall in the NFL draft in the 21st century.
Cam Ward wears No. 1 because Oilers legend Warren Moon gave him permission to bring back the retired number.
The Titans' new uniforms feature a "6-string stripe" running across the helmet, sleeves and pants.
The Titans name is a nod to Nashville's nickname, the "Athens of the South."
T-Rac, the Titans mascot, is a raccoon, which is Tennessee's state animal.
Titans offensive coordinator Brian Daboll owns five Super Bowl rings, all won as a New England Patriots assistant.
Titans offensive coordinator Brian Daboll was born in Welland, Ontario, Canada.
The Titans are playing their final season at Nissan Stadium; a new indoor stadium next door opens in 2027.
As the Houston Oilers, the Titans franchise won the first two AFL championships.
